title: 第十一章 华而不实第十二章 双通道体
content_zh:
看着霍远那老神在在的样子，唐毅忍不住冷哼一声道：“他肯定先前已经照过了问道镜，所以才会如此笃定！”
唐毅的话让众人顿时恍然大悟，问道镜虽然稀罕，但是一些豪门却也有办法弄到。
此刻霍远也已经走到了镜子前面，停下了脚步。
说来也怪，随着霍远的站定，那镜面之上的雾气在微微一滞之后，竟然真的剧烈的翻滚了起来。
“过关！其他人，动作快点，依次上前！”
在肖一书的话音当中，霍远得意洋洋的走到了一边，两关全过，代表着他至少已经是问道宗的外门弟子了。
有了霍远的成功示范，其他人自然也都跃跃欲试起来，一个个的急忙排好了队，依次走向了五面问道镜。
虽然人数众多，但是问道镜的反应也是极为迅速，基本上只有有人上前，镜面上的雾气立刻就会呈现出或动或静的状态。
姜云自然也同样站在队伍之中，看着四周有人欢喜有人忧，他的心中不由得忐忑了起来。
随着前面一人成功的引起了雾气流转，终于轮到姜云了。
悄悄的深吸了口气，姜云站在了问道镜前。
异变再起！
“轰！”
随着姜云刚刚站定，陡然一声巨响响起，那面问道镜赫然炸了开来！
站在镜前的姜云，猝不及防之下，整个人都被镜子炸开的冲击力给撞的腾空而起，向后飞了出去。
整个问道宗，鸦雀无声！
所有人都如同看怪物一样，无数道目光死死的盯着那已经重重摔落在地的姜云！
如果说刚才第一关的时候，姜云的表现是意外的话，那么这一次，绝对就不是意外能够解释的了。
站在问道镜前，竟然能够让问道镜炸开，这样的情况同样从未出现过。
毕竟虽然万物都有道心，但是不能凝聚道灵的却是大有人在，而没有道灵，顶多就是让问道镜上的雾气静止不动而已。

，tHS
如果每个不能凝聚道灵的人站在问道镜前都能让镜子炸开，那任何一个宗门收徒的时候，至少都得准备上千面问道镜。
跌落在地的姜云自然还是一头雾水，不过他能够敏锐的感觉到，就在自己跌落的同时，至少有五六道无形的目光从天而降，集中在了自己的身上，将自己的身体从内到外，从外到内的看了个仔仔细细！
感受着这些目光终于离开了自己的身体，姜云这才悄然吐出一口气，低头看向了自己胸前挂着的那块黑色的三角石头！
因为就在自己站在问道镜前方的时候，这块石头之上似乎闪过了一道幽光，只是紧接着爆炸发生，自己就飞了出去。
可是现在看起来，这块石头之上根本没有任何的光芒，就是一个死物，以至于姜云怀疑自己刚才应该是眼花了。
而死一般的寂静过后，众人也终于回过神来，开始议论纷纷。
content_en:
Looking at the old god Huo Yuan, Tang Yi couldn't help but snorted: "He must have looked in the interrogating mirror before, that's why he is so sure!"
Tang Yi's words made everyone suddenly realize that although the Taoist mirror is rare, some wealthy families can also get it.
At this moment, Huo Yuan had also walked to the mirror and stopped.
Strangely enough, as Huo Yuan stood still, the mist on the mirror actually started to roll violently after a slight stagnation.
"Pass! Others, move quickly and come forward one by one!"
Amid Xiao Yishu's words, Huo Yuan walked aside triumphantly, having passed both tests, which meant that he was at least an outer disciple of the Taoist Sect.
With Huo Yuan's successful demonstration, others were naturally eager to give it a try. They hurriedly lined up one by one and walked towards the five-sided interrogation mirror one by one.
Although there are a large number of people, the reaction of the interrogating mirror is also extremely fast. Basically, as long as someone steps forward, the fog on the mirror will immediately appear to be moving or still.
Naturally, Jiang Yun also stood in the team. Seeing people around him who were happy and others worried, he couldn't help but feel uneasy.
As the person in front successfully caused the mist to flow, it was finally Jiang Yun's turn.
Taking a deep breath quietly, Jiang Yun stood in front of the interrogation mirror.
Changes occur again!
"Boom!"
Just as Jiang Yun stood still, a loud noise suddenly sounded, and the interrogation mirror exploded!
Jiang Yun, who was standing in front of the mirror, was caught off guard. He was thrown into the air by the impact of the mirror exploding and flew backwards.
The entire Taoist sect was completely silent!
Everyone was looking at a monster, with countless eyes staring at Jiang Yun who had fallen heavily to the ground!
If Jiang Yun's performance in the first level just now was an accident, then this time it was definitely not something that could be explained by accident.
Standing in front of the interrogator, he was able to make the interrogator explode. This has never happened before.
After all, although everything has a Taoist heart, there are many people who cannot condense the Taoist spirit. Without the Taoist spirit, at most, the mist on the Taoist mirror will remain still.
,tHS
If every person who cannot condense the Taoist spirit can make the mirror explode when he stands in front of the Taoist mirror, then any sect must prepare at least thousands of Taoist mirrors when accepting disciples.
Jiang Yun, who fell to the ground, was naturally still confused, but he could keenly feel that at the same time as he fell, at least five or six invisible eyes fell from the sky, focusing on his body, looking at his body carefully from the inside to the outside, and from the outside to the inside!
Feeling that these eyes finally left his body, Jiang Yun quietly exhaled and looked down at the black triangular stone hanging on his chest!
Because just when he was standing in front of the interrogation mirror, a faint light seemed to flash on the stone, but then an explosion occurred and he flew out.
But now it seemed that there was no light at all on this stone, and it was just a dead object, so that Jiang Yun suspected that he might have been dazzled just now.
After the deathly silence, everyone finally came to their senses and started talking among themselves.
